title_home: Tamnex | The AI-native ERP for Saudi businesses
desc_home: Tamnex brings accounting, inventory, purchasing and e-invoicing into one system, and shows what blocks your month-end close before the month ends. Monthly and annual plans in SAR.
desc_pricing: Tamnex monthly and annual plans: Core, Business and Advanced, with prices before and after VAT and a full comparison of features and limits.
og_title: Tamnex: the AI-native ERP for your accounting, inventory and invoicing
hero_sub: Forward-thinking finance teams rely on Tamnex to unify accounting and inventory, close their books faster, and track margins and cash in real time.
trust_items: Live performance and margin reports that update with every transaction, so you decide on today's reality.
One connected flow across purchasing, sales and inventory that removes wasted manual entry.
Nexa watches your working-capital cycle, warns you of stock-out risk, and suggests purchasing and pricing decisions.
High-performance cloud interfaces that free your team from the slowness and complexity of legacy systems.
f_title: Your whole business cycle in one system
close_body: Accounting checks that run all month, each exception with an owner and evidence. Try it: clear the three exceptions, then re-run the checks.
cycle_body: Each step builds on the last: no double entry, no manual posting at month end.
ai_body: Reads supplier invoices, suggests bank matches, and answers questions about your numbers in Arabic with sources. Everything Nexa suggests is a draft you approve.
mig_body: Import master data, the trial balance, open invoices and stock, with a mapping you review and approve, then a balance reconciliation.
dist_body: Sales reps, visits and routes, orders and collections in the field, credit limits, and van stock transfers.

prelaunch: Subscriptions open at commercial launch. Choosing a plan sends us your request, and we contact you to confirm the price and the features available at activation. No payment is taken now.
soon_note: “After launch”: included in the plan and available after commercial launch.
pricing_faq: Prices are shown before 15% VAT, with the VAT-inclusive amount under each price.
The full year is paid in advance; its monthly equivalent is shown next to it.
The feature is part of the plan and becomes available to the plan's subscribers when it launches, with no change to the agreed price.
What happens if I choose a plan now?
We receive your request and contact you before launch to confirm price and features. No payment is taken before activation.
faq: Does the AI post or close the period for me?
No. It reads, analyses and prepares drafts; approval and close stay with you or whoever you delegate, and every suggestion is logged.
Can I see cash and margins in real time?
Yes. Every invoice, receipt and collection updates the cash and margin indicators immediately, without waiting for month end.
Yes. Phase 1 (generation and storage) is built into every invoice, and we activate your Fatoora integration (Phase 2) before your wave deadline.
How do I move from my current system?
We import master data, opening balances, open invoices and inventory, and reconcile them with you before you approve.
Does my company get its own address?
Yes. You choose your company subdomain at sign-up, and your team signs in from it directly.
